The closest match is VaLiDRec, by Shutong Qiao and coauthors, which proposes variable-length, LLM-aligned semantic identifiers for generative recommendation and adapts identifier length to item semantic complexity [1]. It also builds SIDs from native LLM vocabulary tokens and reformulates recommendation as token-set prediction instead of autoregressive SID generation [1].

A related earlier paper by the same first author, Qiao et al., studies semantic ID learning with OCR-based text representations, but it does not focus on variable-length semantic IDs [8].
